title: Dr. G as a consortium of anti-submarine scientists, identified by the Ramseys

tellings.quote: Scott and Suzanne Ramsay have really they deserve all the credit for digging up this like kind of like short list of like eight to nine scientists that likely are being represented in this pseudonym Dr. G.

plain: The mysterious scientist known only as "Dr. G" may not have been one man at all, but a stand-in for a group of eight or nine scientists who had worked on anti-submarine research. Dr. G was the source behind a book by the writer Frank Scully called Behind the Flying Saucers, about a saucer said to have come down near Aztec, New Mexico, around 1948. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells this, giving all the credit to two researchers, Scott Ramsey and Suzanne Ramsey, for digging up the short list of names behind the pseudonym.
